svg.title: A middle polarizer between crossed filters
svg.desc: With unpolarized incident light, a middle filter rotates between two crossed outer filters. Sequential projections produce zero transmission at either endpoint and a maximum of one eighth of incident intensity at 45 degrees. Animated motion has a static alternative for reduced motion and print.

g.text: A middle polarizer transmits light through crossed filters
Unpolarized input I0; first and last axes stay crossed
Sequential projections: I out/I0 = ½ cos²θ sin²θ. Maximum is 1/8 at 45°; transmission is zero at 0°,
90°, or with the middle filter removed (ideal filters).
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
